title: How to Create a Sidebar | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Create a Sidebar Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047136 To create a new sidebar, navigate to Toolbox » Sidebar Manager , then click the " New Sidebar " button: Then name the new sidebar: The new sidebar is ready to use: The new sidebar starts out empty. Click Edit to search for widgets and drag them into place. See Toolbox » Sidebar Manager for the full editing steps and Popular Sidebar Widgets for widget suggestions. Tip: If an existing sidebar is close to what is needed, cloning it from the Actions drop-down can be faster than building a new one from scratch. Additional Information: » Toolbox » Sidebar Manager For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
